items.sentenceTrans: Which language do you want to learn?

whyWrong.Quel: Quel is masculine; langue is feminine — Quelle.
whyWrong.Quels: Quels is masculine plural; langue is feminine singular — Quelle.
whyWrong.Quelles: Quelles is plural; langue is singular — Quelle.

whyWrong.Quelle: Quelle is singular; langues is plural — Quelles.
whyWrong.Quels: Quels is masculine; langues is feminine — Quelles.
whyWrong.Quel: Quel is masculine singular; langues is feminine plural — Quelles.

items.fullSentence: Mes parents parlent chinois et anglais.
items.sentenceTrans: My parents speak Chinese and English.

whyWrong.parle: parle goes with je/il/elle; parents (ils) takes parlent.
whyWrong.parles: parles goes with tu; parents (ils) takes parlent.
whyWrong.parler: parler is the infinitive; the conjugated ils form is parlent.

items.fullSentence: À la maison, nous parlons français.

whyWrong.parlent: parlent goes with ils/elles, not nous — parlons.
whyWrong.parle: parle goes with je/il/elle, not nous — parlons.
whyWrong.parlez: parlez goes with vous, not nous — parlons.

items.why: After parler, a language takes no article: on parle français, je parle anglais. (The article comes back with other verbs: j'aime le français.)

whyWrong.du français: No partitive after parler either — just on parle français.
whyWrong.la France: La France is the country; the language is français.
whyWrong.française: française is the adjective (une chanson française) — the language is français; after parler: on parle français.

items.fullSentence: À Singapour, on parle anglais et chinois.
items.sentenceTrans: In Singapore, people speak English and Chinese.

whyWrong.avec: avec means 'with'; listing two languages needs 'et' (and).
whyWrong.mais: mais means 'but'; the two languages are simply added with 'et'.
whyWrong.ou: ou means 'or'; both are spoken, so 'et' (and).

items.fullSentence: Non, je ne parle pas allemand.

whyWrong.parle ne pas: The negation is misplaced — ne goes before the verb: ne parle pas.
whyWrong.ne parler pas: parler is the infinitive; with 'je' you conjugate: ne parle pas.
whyWrong.n'parle pas: ne only elides to n' before a vowel; before 'parle' it stays ne parle pas.

whyWrong.quels: Grammatical for several countries — but you come from one: quel.
whyWrong.quelles: Feminine plural — pays here is masculine singular.

whyWrong.Quel: Grammatical for one country — but the meaning here is several: Quels.
